Battle of the Ancre.fact: A German aircraft followed two of the British aircraft to their base and bombed the aerodrome, leaving craters in the landing-ground. A dummy landing-ground was illuminated as a ruse and was machine-gunned by a German aircraft later that night.

Battle of the Ancre.fact: There was good flying weather from 16 to 17 November and frost which improved the going for the infantry. Battle of the Ancre.fact: Other squadrons raided supply dumps at Courselles and Logeast Wood.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema

Battle of the Ancre.fact: In V Corps, the 37th Division relieved the 63rd (Royal Naval) Division and linked with the 51st (Highland) Division to the north. Bombing attacks began up Beaucourt Trench towards Munich Trench, which reached the 51st (Highland) Division around 10:00 a.m.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: Companies of the 51st (_____) Division and the 2nd Division attacked at 9:00 a.m
Battle of the Ancre.fact: In V Corps, the 37th Division relieved the 63rd (Royal Naval) Division and linked with the 51st (Highland) Division to the north. Bombing attacks began up Beaucourt Trench towards Munich Trench, which reached the 51st (Highland) Division around 10:00 a.m.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: Bombing attacks began up _____ towards Munich Trench, which reached the 51st (Highland) Division around 10:00 a.m
Battle of the Ancre.fact: Bombing attacks began up Beaucourt Trench towards Munich Trench, which reached the 51st (Highland) Division around 10:00 a.m.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: Patrols to Muck and _____ trenches found them empty (except for mud)
Battle of the Ancre.fact: Patrols to Muck and Railway trenches found them empty (except for mud).

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: and were caught in their barrage, some troops reaching _____ then returning to New Munich Trench
Battle of the Ancre.fact: and were caught in their barrage, some troops reaching Frankfort Trench then returning to New Munich Trench.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: After dark, the 37th Division, in the V Corps area, pushed up _____ and set up posts in Bois d'Hollande and at Railway and Muck trenches
Battle of the Ancre.fact: After dark, the 37th Division, in the V Corps area, pushed up Ancre Trench and set up posts in Bois d'Hollande and at Railway and Muck trenches.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: The 32nd _____, from II Corps reserve, took over from the 2nd Division on the northern defensive flank, where there was considerable confusion over the location of the front line
Battle of the Ancre.fact: A 2nd Division attack with two battalions of the 37th Division lost direction in the mist and fell back to Wagon Road with many casualties; a third battalion strengthened the left flank by bombing forward and building a strong point in the Quadrilateral, near the top of Redan Ridge; two tanks in support had soon bogged down. After dark, the 37th Division, in the V Corps area, pushed up Ancre Trench and set up posts in Bois d'Hollande and at Railway and Muck trenches.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: During the night the right linked up with the 51st (Highland) Division at _____ and Leave Avenue
Battle of the Ancre.fact: During the night the right linked up with the 51st (Highland) Division at New Munich Trench and Leave Avenue.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: During 17 _____, the 32nd Division extended to the right to relieve the 51st (Highland) Division
Battle of the Ancre.fact: During 17 November, the 32nd Division extended to the right to relieve the 51st (Highland) Division. By the morning of 16 November, Gough had heard that Munich and Frankfort Trenches were still held by the Germans and that casualties had been more severe than hoped.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: By the morning of 16 _____, Gough had heard that Munich and Frankfort Trenches were still held by the Germans and that casualties had been more severe than hoped

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: After consultations with his subordinates, _____ asked for permission to continue for two more days, weather permitting, which was given that evening
Battle of the Ancre.fact: After consultations with his subordinates, Gough asked for permission to continue for two more days, weather permitting, which was given that evening. By the morning of 16 November, Gough had heard that Munich and Frankfort Trenches were still held by the Germans and that casualties had been more severe than hoped.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: Attacks against Serre were abandoned and the main effort was made on 18 November by _____ pushing down towards the south bank of the Ancre
Battle of the Ancre.fact: Attacks against Serre were abandoned and the main effort was made on 18 November by II Corps pushing down towards the south bank of the Ancre.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: V Corps, on the north bank, was to provide flank support by capturing Frankfort Trench, advancing along _____ and taking Bois d'Hollande
Battle of the Ancre.fact: V Corps, on the north bank, was to provide flank support by capturing Frankfort Trench, advancing along Ancre Trench and taking Bois d'Hollande.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: The attack was delayed until 18 _____, to be certain that preparations were complete
Battle of the Ancre.fact: By the morning of 16 November, Gough had heard that Munich and Frankfort Trenches were still held by the Germans and that casualties had been more severe than hoped. Attacks against Serre were abandoned and the main effort was made on 18 November by II Corps pushing down towards the south bank of the Ancre.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: The first snow fell on the night of _____/18 November and the attack at 6:10 a.m
Battle of the Ancre.fact: The first snow fell on the night of 17/18 November and the attack at 6:10 a.m.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: In II Corps the 4th _____ was to attack Desire and Desire Support trenches south of Grandcourt, roughly parallel to the Ancre
Battle of the Ancre.fact: In II Corps the 4th Canadian Division was to attack Desire and Desire Support trenches south of Grandcourt, roughly parallel to the Ancre.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: Fire from numerous machine-guns, forced survivors from the 46th _____ to retire
Battle of the Ancre.fact: Fire from numerous machine-guns, forced survivors from the 46th Battalion to retire. The 50th Battalion companies found little German resistance, lost touch with the 11th Brigade to the left, took 100 prisoners and began digging in behind Desire Support Trench, before losses from flanking fire forced them to retreat to Regina Trench.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: Patrols went forward to _____, found a few Germans, then took prisoner a German detachment near Coulee Trench, 620 Germans being captured in all
Battle of the Ancre.fact: Patrols went forward to Grandcourt Trench, found a few Germans, then took prisoner a German detachment near Coulee Trench, 620 Germans being captured in all.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: West of the _____ the 18th (Eastern) Division attacked with the 55th Brigade, which assembled in no man's land on the snow
Battle of the Ancre.fact: West of the Canadians the 18th (Eastern) Division attacked with the 55th Brigade, which assembled in no man's land on the snow. Desire Trench on the right flank next to the Canadians was captured and a gap between the two right-hand battalions was closed by converging grenade attacks.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: Desire Trench on the right flank next to the _____ was captured and a gap between the two right-hand battalions was closed by converging grenade attacks
Battle of the Ancre.fact: West of the Canadians the 18th (Eastern) Division attacked with the 55th Brigade, which assembled in no man's land on the snow. Desire Trench on the right flank next to the Canadians was captured and a gap between the two right-hand battalions was closed by converging grenade attacks.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: The two battalions on the left flank disappeared into a gap where the 19th (_____) Division had lost direction and veered to the left
Battle of the Ancre.fact: and the Germans withdrew. In V Corps, two 63rd (Royal Naval) Division brigades advanced with all four battalions forward and with two in support from the reserve brigade.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: Posts west of Point 66 were withdrawn and Point 66 was connected to _____
Battle of the Ancre.fact: Posts west of Point 66 were withdrawn and Point 66 was connected to Regina Trench.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: Next morning, patrols moved west along the trench and by last light it was found that the _____ had withdrawn from the trench as far as Stump Road
Battle of the Ancre.fact: The battalions had been badly hit by German shellfire and the Germans held on to Point 66 on the Courcelette–Grandcourt road, before bombing attacks westwards along Desire Trench until night fell, which allowed the left flanking battalion to reach part of its objective. Next morning, patrols moved west along the trench and by last light it was found that the Germans had withdrawn from the trench as far as Stump Road.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: The 19th (_____) Division attacked with two brigades
Battle of the Ancre.fact: The new plan for 18 November allowed II Corps a halt of 90 minutes on the first objective and the 19th (Western) Division would then attack Grandcourt and Baillescourt Farm. The 4th Canadian Division and 18th (Eastern) Division would then advance and take Grandcourt Trench to link with the 19th (Western) Division at the east end of Grandcourt.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: Further west, the _____ lost direction in the snow, then found it again but were stopped by uncut wire on the right, with many casualties
Battle of the Ancre.fact: On the right the 57th Brigade advance reached German positions west of Stump road on the boundary of the 18th (Eastern) Division and pressed on before being cut off and taken prisoner; 70 British troops managing to escape much later on. Further west, the British lost direction in the snow, then found it again but were stopped by uncut wire on the right, with many casualties.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: On the left, troops got into the Grandcourt line and pushed across Battery Valley on a front of 300 yd (_____), into the south-west part of Grandcourt
Battle of the Ancre.fact: On the left, troops got into the Grandcourt line and pushed across Battery Valley on a front of 300 yd (270 m), into the south-west part of Grandcourt.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: The 56th _____ advanced on the St Pierre Divion–Grandcourt road and along the railway to meet V Corps at Beaucourt
Battle of the Ancre.fact: On the right the 57th Brigade advance reached German positions west of Stump road on the boundary of the 18th (Eastern) Division and pressed on before being cut off and taken prisoner; 70 British troops managing to escape much later on. The 56th Brigade advanced on the St Pierre Divion–Grandcourt road and along the railway to meet V Corps at Beaucourt.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: On the right, where the ground to the right of _____ was firm, the attack reached the west end of Grandcourt and the attackers bombed their way to the 57th Brigade troops already there
Battle of the Ancre.fact: On the right, where the ground to the right of Hansa Road was firm, the attack reached the west end of Grandcourt and the attackers bombed their way to the 57th Brigade troops already there.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: The ground on the railway and the road at the edge of _____ was consolidated by Royal Engineers
Battle of the Ancre.fact: The 56th Brigade advanced on the St Pierre Divion–Grandcourt road and along the railway to meet V Corps at Beaucourt. On the right, where the ground to the right of Hansa Road was firm, the attack reached the west end of Grandcourt and the attackers bombed their way to the 57th Brigade troops already there.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: V _____ attacked with two divisions north of the Ancre
Battle of the Ancre.fact: The left battalion of the division was to capture Baillescourt Farm on the north bank of the Ancre but one company was stopped by machine-gun fire from Grandcourt, as the other advanced along the railway embankment and sent out a patrol which met one from V Corps. V Corps attacked with two divisions north of the Ancre.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: The 37th _____ moved on its right through Beaucourt and at about 1:00 a.m., established posts from Bois d'Hollonde west to the Puisieux road and south to Ancre Trench
Battle of the Ancre.fact: The left battalion of the division was to capture Baillescourt Farm on the north bank of the Ancre but one company was stopped by machine-gun fire from Grandcourt, as the other advanced along the railway embankment and sent out a patrol which met one from V Corps. V Corps attacked with two divisions north of the Ancre.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: At dawn both brigades held _____ and were ready to advance, once the 32nd Division on the left captured Frankfort Trench
Battle of the Ancre.fact: At dawn both brigades held Muck Trench and were ready to advance, once the 32nd Division on the left captured Frankfort Trench.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: Puisieux Trench was entered with difficulty and captured down to the Ancre and a patrol met the 19th (_____) Division troops on the railway
Battle of the Ancre.fact: Puisieux Trench was entered with difficulty and captured down to the Ancre and a patrol met the 19th (Western) Division troops on the railway.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: The 32nd _____ was to attack Munich and Frankfort trenches, between Leave Avenue and Lager Alley
Battle of the Ancre.fact: At dawn both brigades held Muck Trench and were ready to advance, once the 32nd Division on the left captured Frankfort Trench. At zero hour, patrols found German troops in Railway Trench; further to the left British troops bombed their way to the junction of Leave Avenue and Frankfort Trench, where the meeting with the 32nd Division was expected.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: On the right the 97th _____ advanced with all four battalions at 6:10 a.m., through sleet and the right-hand battalion was soon stopped by machine-gun fire
Battle of the Ancre.fact: On the right the 97th Brigade advanced with all four battalions at 6:10 a.m., through sleet and the right-hand battalion was soon stopped by machine-gun fire. Further left the junction of Lager Alley was captured and down the hill, touch was gained with the 14th Brigade.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: The right flank of the centre right battalion was also stopped but further left the advance reached Munich and _____ trenches, where the British were cut off and captured
Battle of the Ancre.fact: The 32nd Division was to attack Munich and Frankfort trenches, between Leave Avenue and Lager Alley. The right flank of the centre right battalion was also stopped but further left the advance reached Munich and Frankfort trenches, where the British were cut off and captured.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: Troops on the left were stopped at a strongpoint in _____ and held on in no-man's-land until dark
Battle of the Ancre.fact: Troops on the left were stopped at a strongpoint in Munich Trench and held on in no-man's-land until dark.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: Further left the junction of _____ was captured and down the hill, touch was gained with the 14th Brigade
Battle of the Ancre.fact: Further left the junction of Lager Alley was captured and down the hill, touch was gained with the 14th Brigade. One battalion began early, advanced down Lager Alley, with its left on Serre Trench and descended the valley towards the village, that some troops reached, although most were captured or killed during the day.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: The 14th Brigade was to capture Ten Tree Alley 500 yd (_____) forward and form a defensive flank
Battle of the Ancre.fact: The 14th Brigade was to capture Ten Tree Alley 500 yd (460 m) forward and form a defensive flank.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: The only gain for the brigade was on the left flank near the _____ where a slight advance was made and consolidated
Battle of the Ancre.fact: The only gain for the brigade was on the left flank near the Quadrilateral where a slight advance was made and consolidated.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: a hurricane bombardment began on the German front line and a mine went off in the 1 July mine crater on _____
Battle of the Ancre.fact: a hurricane bombardment began on the German front line and a mine went off in the 1 July mine crater on Hawthorn Ridge.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: Around Serre, the 52nd _____ began the defence of the village, which lasted for several days
Battle of the Ancre.fact: Around Serre, the 52nd Division began the defence of the village, which lasted for several days. Troops of the division had detected British digging in no-man's-land despite the fog and a patrol reported the British approach.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: Troops of the division had detected _____ digging in no-man's-land despite the fog and a patrol reported the British approach
Battle of the Ancre.fact: Troops of the division had detected British digging in no-man's-land despite the fog and a patrol reported the British approach. Confusion caused by the mist allowed the British to get into the first two trenches north of Serre, which were eventually recaptured.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: Confusion caused by the mist allowed the _____ to get into the first two trenches north of Serre, which were eventually recaptured
Battle of the Ancre.fact: Troops of the division had detected British digging in no-man's-land despite the fog and a patrol reported the British approach. Confusion caused by the mist allowed the British to get into the first two trenches north of Serre, which were eventually recaptured.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: After about two hours, the _____ attack abated, when cheers were heard from Beaumont Hamel behind them and a line of German troops were seen in the mist, guarded by British troops
Battle of the Ancre.fact: The British arrived at intervals in scattered groups, many smoking cigarettes and with their rifles slung. Signal rockets were fired for the artillery but in the fog went unseen and the rest were thrown into no-man's-land to illuminate the British as they drew close, many of them falling into German trenches as they were shot.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: The mist lifted a little and many lines and waves of _____ troops were seen on the right flank advancing unopposed
Battle of the Ancre.fact: The British arrived at intervals in scattered groups, many smoking cigarettes and with their rifles slung. Signal rockets were fired for the artillery but in the fog went unseen and the rest were thrown into no-man's-land to illuminate the British as they drew close, many of them falling into German trenches as they were shot.

Battle of the Ancre.subject: Indian Cinema
Battle of the Ancre.question: A defensive flank was formed and fire opened on the _____, causing many casualties, before a machine-gun began firing at them from behind and to the left, forcing them under cover
Battle of the Ancre.fact: Signal rockets were fired for the artillery but in the fog went unseen and the rest were thrown into no-man's-land to illuminate the British as they drew close, many of them falling into German trenches as they were shot. After about two hours, the British attack abated, when cheers were heard from Beaumont Hamel behind them and a line of German troops were seen in the mist, guarded by British troops.
